description: This file defines the SearchFormController class, which manages the display of a search form in the SuiteCRM UI, including assigning search query parameters to a template.

classes.name: SearchFormController
classes.description: Controller for the search form, handling display logic and assigning search parameters to the view.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller with a SearchQuery object and calls parent constructor with a new SearchFormView.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares the Smarty template with search query data and calls the parent display method.
